title: Holy priest at 15 percent mana in a fight: keeps healing, spends no mana on damage spells

rules.desc: A Holy priest with under 60 percent mana casts no Smite, Holy Fire, Mind Blast or Shadow Word: Pain on the mob: its own mana is kept for heals
rules.source: ai/playerbot/HealerManaPolicy.h:103-130 (HealerDpsManaFloor: 70 percent on an easy or even fight, 85 on a hard one; HealerDpsManaAllows); ai/playerbot/strategy/triggers/GenericTriggers.cpp:205-224 (healer should attack: the mana floor); ai/playerbot/strategy/priest/PriestStrategy.cpp:675 (the row); TortoiseBots upstream/dev 0c56cf649
rules.why_expect: the bot starts at 15 percent and heals only spend mana, so it never reaches the 70 percent floor of the off-spec row inside a 180 s fight; the wand (Shoot, no mana) is not counted. Expected PASS on TortoiseBots upstream/dev 0c56cf649

rules.desc: A Holy priest at low mana still casts heals or shields on the player: at least 3 casts by the bot on the player in the fight (a drained healer that stalls fails here)
rules.source: ai/playerbot/HealerManaPolicy.h:55-69 (ShouldStartHeal never vetoes a target at or under lowHealth; only LOW-efficiency heals are held back under the mana reserve line); ai/playerbot/strategy/priest/HolyPriestStrategy.cpp:29-72; TortoiseBots upstream/dev 0c56cf649
rules.why_expect: the player falls under 50 percent several times (hp_band 35-80), where no heal is vetoed, but 15 percent of a level 40 priest's mana is a handful of casts; whether it is 3 or more is the open question
